project_name: 30-Day Automated Machine Learning Daily Learning Assistant

learning_objectives: Deconstruct the core taxonomy: Supervised, Unsupervised, Semi-supervised, and Reinforcement Learning
Formulate Mitchell's definition of machine learning: Task T, Performance P, Experience E
Analyze the inductive bias and generalization bounds across parametric vs non-parametric paradigms
Implement a foundational end-to-end learning verification script using NumPy and Scikit-Learn
roadmap.title: Introduction to Machine Learning

learning_objectives: Master vectorized SIMD array computations, striding, broadcasting, and memory layouts (C vs Fortran order) in NumPy
Manipulate structured dataFrames with Pandas: hierarchical indexing, memory optimization (downcasting), and vectorized string/datetime transformations
Implement efficient numerical matrix algebra: dot products, Frobenius norms, and singular value decomposition
Construct production visualization templates using Matplotlib Agg headless backend
Diagnose missing data mechanisms: Missing Completely at Random (MCAR), Missing at Random (MAR), and Missing Not at Random (MNAR)
Implement iterative multivariate feature imputation (MICE) and KNN imputation with strict train/test isolation
Detect and treat statistical outliers using Z-scores, Interquartile Range (IQR), and Isolation Forests
Transform non-Gaussian skewed feature distributions via Box-Cox and Yeo-Johnson power transforms
Derive the closed-form Ordinary Least Squares normal equation: theta = (X^T X)^(-1) X^T y
Verify Gauss-Markov theorem conditions: linearity, homoscedasticity, uncorrelated errors, and exogeneity
Implement closed-form and iterative gradient-descent linear regressors in pure NumPy and Scikit-Learn
Analyze geometric projection of response vector y onto the column space of feature matrix X
Deconstruct MAE, MSE, RMSE, RMSLE, and MAPE: sensitivity to outliers and error penalty surfaces
Derive R-squared and Adjusted R-squared: penalizing redundant predictor additions against degrees of freedom
Diagnose residual diagnostic plots: Cook's distance, leverage points, Q-Q normality, and heteroscedasticity
Implement asymmetric business cost loss functions for regression evaluation
Deconstruct expected test prediction error into irreducible error, squared bias, and model variance
Apply PolynomialFeatures and spline basis expansions to model complex non-linear relationships
Analyze Runge's phenomenon and high-degree polynomial oscillatory boundary instabilities
Plot empirical learning curves to diagnose underfitting vs overfitting regimes
Formulate L1 (Lasso) and L2 (Ridge) penalized objective functions and geometric constraint surfaces
Explain why L1 penalty geometry induces exact coordinate sparsity while L2 induces continuous weight shrinkage
Implement ElasticNet balancing L1 feature selection and L2 collinear feature grouping properties
Automate penalty parameter selection with RidgeCV, LassoCV, and ElasticNetCV
Derive the logistic sigmoid function, log-odds (logit) formulation, and Bernoulli likelihood
Formulate the Binary Cross-Entropy (Log-Loss) convex cost function and gradient update equations
Extend binary logistic classification to Softmax Multinomial regression with L1/L2 penalties
Interpret model coefficients as multiplicative odds ratios for executive decision stakeholders
Analyze geometric distance metrics: Euclidean, Manhattan, Minkowski, Cosine, and Mahalanobis
Explain the curse of dimensionality and why Euclidean distances converge in high-dimensional spaces
Benchmark brute-force distance queries against spatial partitioning trees (KD-Trees, Ball Trees)
Implement distance-weighted KNN with adaptive k selection and out-of-fold cross validation
Derive Bayes' Theorem for posterior estimation: P(y|X) = [P(X|y) * P(y)] / P(X)
Examine the conditional feature independence assumption and its mathematical consequences
Implement Gaussian, Multinomial, and Bernoulli Naive Bayes variants with Laplace smoothing
Construct an enterprise spam categorization and text classification pipeline with TF-IDF features
Derive the maximum margin hyperplane optimization problem maximizing geometric separation 2 / ||w||
Formulate soft-margin SVM with slack variables (C parameter) using Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) dual formulation
Apply the Kernel Trick via Mercer's theorem using RBF, Polynomial, and Sigmoid kernels
Calibrate gamma and C hyperparameters to balance decision boundary smoothness vs classification fidelity
Calculate Shannon Entropy, Information Gain (ID3), and Gini Impurity (CART) for recursive partitioning
Implement continuous covariate split-point optimization and surrogate splits for missing features
Prevent tree overfitting using pre-pruning (max_depth, min_samples_leaf) and post-pruning (Cost Complexity alpha)
Visualize hierarchical decision surfaces and verify scale invariance across monotonic transformations
Derive variance reduction across ensembles of uncorrelated base estimators via bootstrap aggregation
Explain how random feature subspace sampling (mtry) decorrelates individual decision trees
Compute Out-of-Bag (OOB) error estimates as an embedded validation surrogate
Contrast Mean Decrease Impurity (MDI) with Permutation Feature Importance to avoid cardinality bias
Deconstruct the Confusion Matrix into Precision, Recall, Specificity, Fall-out, and F-beta scores
Analyze Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC-AUC) curves vs Precision-Recall (PR-AUC) dynamics under imbalance
Calibrate predicted probabilities using Platt Scaling (sigmoid) and Isotonic Regression
Optimize decision classification thresholds based on asymmetric operational cost-benefit matrices
Analyze Condorcet's Jury Theorem and the theoretical mathematical power of ensemble aggregation
Compare Hard Voting (majority rule) vs Soft Voting (confidence-weighted probability averaging)
Implement Stacking (Stacked Generalization) with cross-validated out-of-fold meta-learners
Construct heterogeneous ensemble architectures blending linear, tree-based, and distance models
Derive AdaBoost exponential loss minimization and sequential sample weight updating formulas (SAMME)
Formulate Gradient Boosting as functional gradient descent optimization in function space
Derive negative gradient pseudo-residuals for arbitrary differentiable regression and classification losses
Apply learning rate shrinkage and stochastic subsampling to control sequential overfitting
Master the 2nd-order Taylor expansion objective (first-order gradients g_i and second-order hessians h_i)
Formulate optimal leaf weight calculations and split gain scoring with L1 (alpha) and L2 (lambda) penalties
Explain Exact Greedy vs Weighted Quantile Sketch approximate histogram split finding algorithms
Tune regularization hyperparameters: gamma (minimum split loss), colsample_bytree, and subsample
Design robust validation topologies: K-Fold, Stratified K-Fold, GroupKFold, and TimeSeriesSplit
Identify data leakage vulnerability points during split generation and automated feature pipelines
Compute nested cross-validation to produce unbiased generalization error estimates during model selection
Construct out-of-fold prediction matrices for stacked generalization and performance audits
Compare Grid Search, Randomized Search, and Sequential Model-Based Optimization (SMBO/Bayesian)
Formulate Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE) modeling P(x|y) to sample high-performing parameters
Implement early trial pruning strategies using Hyperband and Median stopping algorithms in Optuna
Visualize hyperparameter importance, slice plots, and multi-objective Pareto frontiers
Derive Lloyd's Expectation-Maximization algorithm minimizing within-cluster sum of squares (Inertia)
Explain K-Means++ probabilistic seeding guarantees ($O(\log k)$ approximation bound) against local minima
Determine optimal cluster count using the Elbow Method, Silhouette Analysis, and Davies-Bouldin index
Address spherical assumptions, sensitivity to variable scaling, and outlier vulnerability in K-Means
Construct Agglomerative Hierarchical trees with Ward, Complete, and Average linkage criteria and dendrograms
Formulate density-based spatial clustering (DBSCAN) using epsilon neighborhoods, core points, and noise classification
Derive Principal Component Analysis (PCA) via covariance matrix eigenvalue decomposition and SVD
Synthesize explained variance ratios and scree plots to project high-dimensional data onto orthogonal axes
Engineer domain features: non-linear interactions, polynomial ratios, binning, and rolling time aggregations
Encode high-cardinality categoricals: Target Encoding with smoothing, Weight of Evidence (WoE), and CatBoost encoding
Perform statistical feature selection: Mutual Information, ANOVA F-value, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE)
Enforce strict fit/transform encapsulation to guarantee zero leakage into validation sets
Review probability fundamentals: Joint, Marginal, Conditional distributions, and Central Limit Theorem (CLT)
Execute parametric hypothesis testing: Student's t-test, ANOVA, and Chi-Square goodness-of-fit tests
Analyze covariance matrices, Pearson vs Spearman rank correlations, and confounding collinear variables
Synthesize statistical intuition behind loss functions, confidence intervals, and p-value interpretations
Construct enterprise Scikit-Learn Pipelines subclassing BaseEstimator and TransformerMixin
Design ColumnTransformer architectures routing numerical, categorical, and text streams concurrently
Integrate automated feature selection and estimator fitting into single immutable pipeline objects
Ensure pipeline reproducibility and clean parameter tuning via nested parameter grid notation
Perform statistical significance testing between model candidates using McNemar's Test and 5x2cv Paired t-test
Deconstruct residual and prediction error distributions across sub-populations and feature slices
Identify slice-based performance degradations, algorithmic fairness disparities, and edge failure cases
Compile automated model benchmarking leaderboards with latency, memory, and accuracy metrics
Compare serialization formats: Joblib, Pickle, ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange), and Treelite
Benchmark serialization security, memory footprint, cold-start latency, and cross-platform compatibility
Implement high-throughput batch inference and single-record low-latency scoring scripts
Validate input payload schemas and data type integrity before passing to serialized model objects

roadmap.topic: Deploying an ML Model Using FastAPI
learning_objectives: Build an asynchronous, non-blocking REST API for real-time model inference using FastAPI and Uvicorn
Enforce strict input and output contract validation with Pydantic v2 schemas
Implement health check probes, dependency injection, and Prometheus inference latency metrics
Structure multi-stage Docker container specifications for zero-cost cloud microservice hosting
Execute an end-to-end industrial regression system: exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and modeling
Tune Ridge, ElasticNet, and LightGBM regressors with automated cross-validated hyperparameter sweeps
Conduct thorough residual diagnostics: heteroscedasticity, Cook's distance, and outlier influence tests
Deliver a complete production deployment artifact with verified inference metrics and documentation
Build an end-to-end enterprise classification pipeline on an imbalanced operational dataset
Apply preprocessing, resampling strategies (SMOTE), and cost-sensitive threshold optimization
Benchmark XGBoost, Random Forest, and Calibrated Logistic Regression candidate models
Implement SHAP TreeExplainer to produce global feature importance and local individual prediction explanations
Synthesize the complete 30-day curriculum: foundations, regression, classification, ensembles, and MLOps
Conduct an advanced ML System Design interview simulation: scale, latency, drift monitoring, and tradeoffs
Review senior machine learning interview questions across all 4 weeks with architectural justifications
Finalize personal machine learning portfolio, presentation decks, and lifelong mastery roadmaps
